source: HCES 2023-24 unit-level clean parquet, levels 01, 03, 05, 06, 14 and 15
suppression: a cell with fewer than min_cell_households unweighted households is null; its unweighted count n_* is kept (ruling R16)
mean_mpce_definition: person-weighted over households with mpce_status OK: sum(w * MPCE * hh_size) / sum(w * hh_size)
group_mean_definition: household-weighted means among households reporting the group; reporting_share is the weighted share reporting it; unreported items are not zero-filled
unit_value_definition: market purchases only: cons_total minus cons_home; pulses leave out PDS 158 and free 071 and 072 (rulings R15, R17)
